title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to traffic safety in and around the intersection of 60th Street and 10th Avenue.
text:
[Council File 26-1374; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to traffic safety in and around the intersection of 60th Street and 10th Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Harris-Dawson – Hutt):
INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation, working with the City Administrative Officer (CAO), to report within 14 days with the following:
A traffic safety assessment of the intersection of 60th Street and 10th Avenue, as well as the residential segment along 60th Street adjacent to the intersection
Options for appropriate permanent and/or temporary traffic calming measures at the intersection of 60th Street and 10th Avenue, including but not limited to:
Increased signage
Updated striping
Speed humps
The identification of potential funding options for any of the identified traffic calming measures.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
summary: City motion to improve traffic safety at the intersection of 60th Street and 10th Avenue.
